comment: Official texts the law library is imported from. Import with: dotnet run --project src/DzLegal.Harness -- law import <id> --url <official url> (or --file <downloaded file>). officialSite is where the lawyer can check the text before it is imported; joReference (Journal Officiel issue) is to be filled by a lawyer. Links must be https on joradp.dz or mjustice.dz. References are to be confirmed by a lawyer (see docs/LAW-LIBRARY.md).
